facts.business: IOL Chemicals and Pharmaceuticals Limited manufactures and sells bulk drugs and chemical products, including paracetamol, with operations in India and exports to Switzerland, Indonesia, and other countries.
key_risks: Revenue recognition risk due to high volume of year-end sales transactions
Impairment risk of property, plant and equipment due to changes in assumptions on future cash flows
Post-retirement benefit plan risk from actuarial assumption changes
Deferred tax asset recognition risk dependent on future profitability
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with subsidiaries (IOL Foundation, IOL Speciality Chemicals Limited, IOL Pharmaxis UK Limited), enterprises controlled by KMPs (NM Merchantiles Limited, Mayadevi Polycot Limited, NCVI Enterprises Limited, Varinder Gupta HUF), KMPs, non-executive directors, and post-employment benefit plan (Gratuity Trust).
